tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search the notavibe catalog of open-source projects. The query matches project name, project description, and the category, ecosystem, kind, runtime, license_family and capabilities vocabulary facets; free-form repository topics are not matched. capabilities names what a project does, such as http-c

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Return the public profile of one catalog project, identified by host and either an owner/repo slug or a numeric repository id. host and exactly one of slug or id are required; a call missing them, giving both slug and id, or giving a host other than github or gitlab or a slug that is a URL or ends i

tools.name: compare_projects
tools.description: Return the public profiles of two catalog projects side by side, identified by host and two owner/repo slugs. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_projects" is 3832 chars, far longer than this server's median (432). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
